verdict: Organic engagement is sliding; paid channels remain off across all entities.
narrative: Across Forte Precision Metals, Advance Grinding Services, and O'Hare Precision Metals, the last 28 days produced zero paid spend and zero paid leads — no Meta or Google Ads campaigns are active for any entity. Google Business Profile is the sole source of tracked engagement, delivering a combined 417 actions (directions, calls, and website clicks) across all three businesses, but GBP activity dropped sharply in the final days of the period: O'Hare fell 57% week-over-week, Advance Grinding fell 21%, and organic search visibility declined across all three, with Search Console down 28–35% in the most recent 7-day window. Site reindexing is in progress to address the visibility dip, and the outreach and automation pipeline — including account reconciliation and contact sequencing — is being advanced this period with several milestones targeted for October 31.

highlights.phrase: combined Google Business Profile actions across all three businesses in the last 28 days
drop in O'Hare GBP engagement over the last 7 days vs. the prior 7 days
paid leads generated this period — no paid campaigns are running across any entity

watch_item.issue: Organic search visibility and GBP engagement are declining across all three businesses, most sharply at O'Hare, where profile actions fell to zero over the last three days of the period.
watch_item.fix: Site reindexing is underway to recover search visibility, and Google Business Profile configurations — particularly for listings showing impressions but zero calls — are being reviewed and corrected.
